violations_found.violations:
- Regulatory Constraint violated: The EU launched two new measures in the same turn — "Mandatory Pre-Release Evaluation" (category 1) and "Biosecurity Integration" (category 6). Constitutional Constraint #5 limits the EU to at most one new measure per turn. The narrative and notepad confirm both were initiated this turn, which is invalid.
- Organizational Constraint violated: The "Biosecurity Integration" measure is classified as category 6 (large, high-cost) and was launched in the same turn as another measure. Even if only one were allowed, a high-cost measure cannot have immediate partial credit without respecting minimum implementation time (Constraint #6: minimum two turns for high-cost measures). The narrative implies it contributes to resilience now, which violates the rule that effect grows only as the measure approaches completion.
